help.body: Drag anywhere: a short drag moves the pack one lane, and a longer drag moves more lanes. A tap moves one lane toward the side you tap. Keys: arrows, A/D or H/L. Some obstacles move: an arrow shows each one's first move.
help.title: Switch lanes

help.body: Tips are {tip} each, on top of each dog's pay. A treat gives its dog's owner +{treatHearts}♥, or {treatCash} when every owner is full. Aim for a lost wallet or a friendly neighbour, and grab dropped gear: it works for the rest of the walk.
help.title: Tips, treats and finds

help.body: Skunks, thieves, dogs and more open cards. Each option costs cash, hearts or a debuff, and at least one is free of cash. Puddles and a few others give a debuff, not a bump. Debuffs wear off in time. Hold anything for details.
help.title: Some obstacles bring cards

help.body: Owners have {smallHearts}♥ small, {mediumHearts}♥ medium, {largeHearts}♥ large. Small dogs dodge 1 in {dodgeIn} bumps and speed up lane changes; large dogs slow them. A lone dog's owner gets +{loneBonus}♥, a pair's lead +{pairBonus}♥. A bump costs that dog's owner {bumpHearts}♥. At 0♥ the owner fires you.
help.title: Keep owners happy

help.body: Touching a squirrel does nothing, but a bubble and a line to it mean a dog is straining. Steer away and the pull is off; wait and the pack lurches one lane toward it. A pull never drags you into a bump too close to dodge.
help.title: Watch for pulls

help.body: Walk {walkLength} neighbourhoods of {world}; at a fork, each path brings an upgrade. Bring every dog home for the {walkBonus} Walk bonus. Heading home, or losing every dog, keeps only what each finished neighbourhood earned.
help.title: Neighbourhoods
